explanation: Bermuda sits in the open North Atlantic, about 1,050 km (650 miles) east-south-east of North Carolina's Cape Hatteras, far north of the Caribbean Sea.

claims.text: Bermuda lies in the North Atlantic Ocean, outside the Caribbean Sea.
Bermuda lies about 1,050 km (650 miles) east-south-east of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina.
